items.title: Have a Great Summer!
items.description: That's a wrap on the semester! Thanks to everyone who came out this year. Have a fantastic summer, and we'll see you in the fall!

items.title: VGDC Fall 2026 Kickoff!
items.description: Welcome to the fall 2026 semester and hope everyone had a good summer! Our first meeting will be Wednesday August 19 from 5:30 to 7:30 PM in Math Sciences (MSCS) 445! This meeting will be an introductory meeting for us to talk about the club and introduce all of the officers. It will also be a good chance to meet people, and we will have free pizza! See y'all there!
